description: Defines WebSocket protocol constants, classes for WebSocket link handling, including client and server types, with support for WebSocket upgrade, message encoding/decoding, and activity management within the Thunder Web namespace.

classes.name: WebSocket::Protocol
classes.description: Manages WebSocket frame types, masking, encoding/decoding, and key generation.

classes.name: WebSocket::RequestAllocator
classes.description: Proxy pool for Web::Request objects, singleton instance.

classes.name: WebSocket::ResponseAllocator
classes.description: Proxy pool for Web::Response objects, singleton instance.

classes.name: WebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Template class managing WebSocket link state, message serialization/deserialization, upgrade handling, and activity monitoring for client/server links.

classes.name: WebSocketClientType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket client links, managing connection, data transfer, and upgrade process.

classes.name: WebSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket server links, managing incoming connections, data transfer, and upgrade process.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket response key based on a request key.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes a data frame for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: GenerateMaskKey
methods.description: Generates a masking key for WebSocket frames.
